### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/24029 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

`NewIndex()` relies on `NeedRestoredData`, but it is not initialized in the bootstrap stage.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: Initialize index.needRestoredData lazily

### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/docs`/`pingcap/docs-cn`:
- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test

Side effects

NA

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- Fix row & index inconsistent with new collation enabled after upgrade.

issue_context.title: row & index inconsistent with new collation enabled after tidb-server restarted
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

in 5.0.0 cluster with *new collation enabled*

```
create table t(a int key, b varchar(20) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci, c varchar(20) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, unique key idx_b_c(b, c));
```

restart tidb， then

```
insert into t values (4, 'd', 'F');
admin check table t; 
```

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

success

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

admin check failure

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

5.0.0

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: We may need to create index during upgrade in the future.
If the index creator has no idea about whether `new collation` is enabled, how can it create?
We can enable it at the beginning of `upgrade`.
But we don't need to do it in this PR.
If the `upgrade()` changes the schema of `mysql.tidb`, we will encounter the same problem.
